subject: Invoice origin + short-term PDF push vs portal enrollment
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@bluecrest.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Trent <marcus.trent@bluecrest.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Who will publish invoices / short-term PDF while we enroll in portal?

Hi Jordan —

Quick one from AP as we kick off the pilot: who should appear as the ‘invoice originator’ on Bluecrest invoices? Our procurement system expects a named sender and we need a short-term solution while we get the portal credentials in place.

Options we discussed internally:
- Redwood emails from invoices@redwood.com (simple, we auto-forward into our AP inbox)
- Portal push once enrollment completes (preferred long-term)
- Temporary signed PDF from your billing team (if portal takes >2 weeks)

I attached our vendor W9 — can you confirm the sender and whether we should expect a one-off PDF delivery or plan for portal enrollment this month? Also: we need VAT/evidence tagging in the invoice line items (reverse charge not applicable).

Thanks,
Hannah Li
AP Manager, Bluecrest Analytics
(415) 555-0122

Attachment: Bluecrest_W9.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Marcus Trent <marcus.trent@bluecrest.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Who will publish invoices / short-term PDF while we enroll in portal?

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note and the W9. Short answer: we can do a temporary signed-PDF push this month while we finalize portal enrollment. Plan:

1) We (Redwood) will issue invoices from billing@redwood.com and attach a signed PDF copy for Bluecrest AP.
2) Kimberly (cc'd) will make sure VAT tagging appears on line items and the invoice footer includes our EU VAT ID / reverse-charge text (even though you said it's not applicable, we can include the required metadata).
3) Portal enrollment: we can provision a portal webhook/push within 7–10 business days after we receive the enrollment form — after that invoices will come via API/webhook.

Can you confirm the email address you want invoices delivered to (AP queue) and whether you require PO number on the invoice header? If you can provide a sample PO format, we'll bake it into the template.

I'll create the temporary PDF today and send it to the AP queue if you confirm.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah —

Adding a quick billing ops note: temporary PDF push is fine. A few operational details to make sure the AP system reconciles cleanly:

- Please have the AP queue address be the same as the remit-to for the short-term PDFs (we'll also Bcc your accounting alias for traceability).
- Include these fields in the PO/invoice mapping: PO#, entity name, remit-to alias, tax classification.
- We'll include the following VAT metadata in the invoice JSON when we flip to API: vat_id (if provided), tax_rate (0% if exempt), tax_note -> "reverse charge not applicable".

Ben, can you produce a quick PDF sample using Bluecrest_W9 and the PO example Hannah will send? I'll review then we can send the signed PDF.
